Beksur Govinda ko phansaya hatya ke kes men - Chhote Sarkar Full Movie 4K - Kader Khan, Shilpa Shetty
Ek amir vyapari amar ko uske chacha ki hatya ke lie do andrakvar pulis adhikariyon, sima aur jagmohan dvara phansaya jata hai. jel se bachne ke lie, vah pagal hone ka dava karta hai aur rahasy ko suljhane ki koshish karta hai.
Amar, a rich businessman, is framed by two undercover police officers, Seema and Jagmohan, for the murder of his uncle. To evade prison, he claims to be of unsound mind and tries to solve the mystery.
Movie Name - Chhote Sarkar (1996) chhote sarkar
